boardOnly: Only a person on the board can respond — agents cannot resolve this card.
assignedBoard: Assigned to {{addressee}}. Only a person on the board can respond — agents cannot resolve this card.
addresseeOrBoard: Only {{addressee}} or a person on the board can respond.
exceptCreator: Anyone in the organization except {{creator}} can respond.
anyone: Anyone in the organization can respond — the board or any agent, including the one that asked.
governed: This card runs a governed action, so it stays human-only whatever audience was requested.
companyCap: Organization interaction governance narrowed this from {{requested}} to {{effective}}.
legacy: Created before Anyone became the default, so it stays restricted. A new card would be open.
